posts.text:
GOP  @RepThomasMassie with some rare public truth-telling on elections and Trump’s claims of fraud:

"It's a ruse because we won all the damn elections, and they're complaining about election fraud," Massie told CNN's Manu Raju. "They're saying that the future of our country rests on this election integrity bill. Well, we control the House, we control the Senate, we've got conservatives in a majority in the Supreme Court. And we control the White House. We won all the damn elections. "
